proposals.evidence: DEDR 2674(a) lists Tamil/Malayalam/Kannada uppu, Kolami sup and Parji cup ‘salt’; subsection (b) gives Gondi havar/ovor, Konda sōru and Kuvi hāru. The article supports the family but keeps the two stem series explicit; multiword salt responses are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
